title: API reference tables, code and popups

crops.title: First parameter table, heading plus header and two rows
crops.head: table-light-head.png

items.look_for: Green inline code such as `q: "*"` and `company_name, country` is one step darker (#4f8000 to #497500).
items.note: Too small to see at this scale. The table-chip zoom shows it.

items.look_for: In the header row, "Parameter", "Required" and "Description" lose their wide letter-spacing and sit tighter.
The gap between the "Query parameters" heading and the table shrinks from 20px to 16px. The header row sits 4px higher on HEAD.
Left of "q" in the first row, HEAD shows a small green # link while the row is hovered. Base shows the name alone.

crops.note: The mouse rests on the q row's "yes" cell because the # only shows on hover on desktop. The viewport is 1280x1400 instead of 1280x800 so the heading and two 580px-tall rows fit. The width and layout are unchanged. The Description column starts about 5px further left on HEAD because the tighter "Required" header (39ab66e7) narrows that column.

crops.title: Zoom on one inline code chip in the table
crops.head: table-chip-light-head.png

items.look_for: The green "company_name, country" text is a touch deeper and more olive on HEAD.

crops.note: Subtle. Extra framing at deviceScaleFactor 4 of the chip in the query_by row. Computed colour goes from #4f8000 to #497500. A contrast gate is the firmer check.

crops.title: First code group on its JavaScript tab
crops.head: code-light-head.png

items.look_for: Across the code panel, GitHub's red, navy and purple tokens become the site palette. "let" turns green, strings brown-amber, "client" dark red and the method names plain gray.
On HEAD the three token colours differ in lightness. Green "let" is the lightest, the amber strings sit in the middle and dark red "client" is the darkest.

crops.note: The gray "js" label in the top-right corner also goes (c425dce1).

crops.title: First code group on its JavaScript tab
crops.head: code-dark-head.png

items.look_for: Across the code panel, GitHub's pink, light blue and purple tokens become lime keywords, amber strings, a tomato "client" and gray method names.
The lime, amber and tomato tokens sit at clearly different brightness on HEAD, lime brightest and tomato darkest.

crops.note: The gray "js" label in the top-right corner also goes (c425dce1).

crops.title: Selected text in the first code panel
crops.head: selection-dark-head.png

items.look_for: The selection fill behind the code goes from a bright mid green to a much darker green, and the tokens on it read more clearly.

crops.note: Token colours under the selection also change (5e30f0af) and the "js" label goes (c425dce1).

crops.title: Aside version list open, one row keyboard-focused
crops.head: listbox-dark-head.png

items.look_for: The open version list is a lighter gray than the page on HEAD (#1a1a1f to #23232a). The focused "v30.1" row is lighter still (#222229 to #31303b) and stands out more.

items.note: No visible change is claimed (a refactor of shadcn variant defaults). Nothing in this pair belongs to it. Leave it to a gate or a code read.
No visible change is claimed (screen-reader text only, and the visible footer line is in both builds). Nothing in this pair belongs to it. Leave it to a gate or a code read.

crops.note: The trigger above the list also gains a thin border (819cc8d7).

crops.title: Search modal after typing 'vector search'
crops.head: search-modal-light-head.png

items.look_for: Across the modal, the typed query, the hit titles and the footer labels ("Navigate", "Select", "Close") switch from the system font to the narrower Source Sans 3.
The underlined matches ("Vector Search", "vector search") and "Clear" are one step darker green.
items.note: Too small to see at 1x (primary colour lightness 25% to 23%). The search-modal-zoom pair shows it better.

crops.note: One live query per build, entered with a single fill so each build sent one request. Both builds returned the same five hits.

crops.title: Zoom on the hits in the search modal
crops.head: search-modal-zoom-light-head.png

items.look_for: The green match text and underlines in the selected "Vector Search" hit and the last row read slightly deeper on HEAD.

crops.note: Subtle. This is a 3x pixel zoom of the search-modal captures, so no extra queries ran. The thinner Source Sans 3 strokes from a7a03d39 also change how dark the green reads.

crops.title: On this page outline at scrollY 0
crops.head: outline-light-head.png

items.look_for: In the right column list, "Sample Response" and "Definition" no longer appear under "Search-only API Key". Everything below moves up two rows.

crops.note: Labels such as "Synonym Set Item actions" and "Analytics Rules actions" also wrap differently, from 8da4e8c6. The list is taller than the 900px viewport on both builds, so outline-full shows all of it.

crops.title: Whole On this page outline
crops.head: outline-full-light-head.png

items.look_for: Down the whole list, HEAD drops every "Sample Response" and "Definition" row (42 rows to 33) and ends about 290px shorter.

crops.note: Extra framing with a 1440x1720 viewport so the full outline fits on both builds.
